images.author: Nyttend
images.caption: Front of Kerber's Marine Grocery, located at 1006 Tiffin Avenue (U.S. Route 6) in Sandusky, Ohio, United States.  Built in 1888, it is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

brief: A two-storey corner store: a green-painted clapboard upper floor with a bracketed cornice over a dark brick-and-glass shop floor, a corner door and a painted name board. One photo. Older than 1970: a pre-war main-street building; no newer example of this type on the lake. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: Kerber's Marine Grocery (Sandusky OH, 1890): a two-storey frame corner store with a hip roof and a gabled name pediment ('J. KERBER') over a bracketed cornice, a storefront framed by panelled red brick-patterned pilasters, a thrift shop's sign; flats above

why.note: the corner grocery near the harbour
